target_roles.title: VP of Product Management
target_roles.rationale: EFI's continuous product launches (EFI Pro 30h+ hybrid printer debut at ISA 2025, VUTEk M3h at FESPA 2025) and emphasis on 'durable Genuine EFI Inks' for outdoor applications positions Product Management as the critical strategic owner. This role drives product differentiation in a competitive wide-format printer market where complete solutions matter. Partnering with Tedlar would enable EFI to offer a validated overlaminate recommendation alongside their UV LED printer/ink systems, creating a premium 'total durability solution' that addresses customer pain points around outdoor longevity, UV protection, and graffiti resistance. This enhances EFI's competitive positioning against HP, Canon, and other printer manufacturers by providing customers with proven 12-20+ year outdoor performance—a tangible selling advantage that Product Management can leverage in go-to-market strategy, sales enablement materials, and customer demonstrations at their ISA/FESPA booth presence.

target_roles.title: Director of Business Development
target_roles.rationale: With EFI's massive customer base across sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and architectural graphics producers (the exact end-users who apply protective films), Business Development owns ecosystem partnerships and channel expansion. Tedlar represents a strategic alliance opportunity where EFI can add value to their 1,000+ customer success employees' interactions without competing with their core printer/ink business. This role would recognize that when EFI customers experience premature graphic failures (fading, cracking, graffiti damage), it reflects poorly on the entire print solution—even if the printer/ink performed well. By establishing Tedlar as a recommended overlaminate partner, Business Development can reduce customer churn, increase wallet share through solution bundling, and create co-marketing opportunities at the ISA Sign Expo, FESPA, and PRINTING United events where EFI already exhibits. The partnership supports their outdoor durability messaging while creating a new revenue stream through referral agreements or value-added reseller arrangements.

target_roles.title: VP of Marketing
target_roles.rationale: EFI's market positioning emphasizes 'vibrant, high-resolution prints that are instantly cured, eco-friendly, and long-lasting—ideal for both indoor and outdoor signage.' Marketing owns this brand promise and competitive messaging, but currently lacks a protective film component to complete the durability story. This role is measured on market share growth, brand differentiation, and trade show ROI from their investments in ISA Sign Expo, FESPA Global Print Expo, and PRINTING United—all venues where protective film performance is a key customer concern. Tedlar's 60+ years of proven performance and extreme durability credentials (12-20+ year lifespan, no yellowing/fading) provide Marketing with third-party validation and case studies to strengthen EFI's 'long-lasting outdoor graphics' claims. The VP of Marketing would care about co-branding opportunities, joint customer success stories featuring complete print-to-protection workflows, and content marketing that positions EFI as the total solution provider rather than just an equipment vendor—directly supporting their premium market positioning against competitors.
